ne_chest_wall_pushup.name: Wall Push-up
steps: Stand one step away from the wall, palms on the wall at chest height, shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall, keeping your body straight.
Push back to the starting position.
tips: Step your feet back to add difficulty.
commonMistakes: Hips sticking out forward.

ne_chest_knee_pushup.name: Knee Push-up
steps: Rest on your knees and palms, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest until it almost touches the floor, then push up.
tips: Keep your abs tight throughout the movement.
commonMistakes: Hips rising or sagging.

ne_chest_pushup.name: Standard Push-up
steps: Start in a high plank, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body as one straight line until your chest almost touches the floor.
Push up without locking your elbows.
tips: Keep your elbows about 45° from your body.
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out to 90°.
Head dropping down.

ne_chest_diamond.name: Diamond Push-up
steps: Get into a push-up position with both hands forming a diamond under your chest.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close to your body.
Push up.
tips: Start from your knees if it is too hard.
commonMistakes: Wrist pain from an overly extreme angle.

ne_abs_dead_bug.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees bent at 90° above your hips.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg without touching the floor.
Return, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
commonMistakes: Lower back arching.

ne_abs_crunch.name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Lower slowly.
tips: Exhale as you come up.
commonMistakes: Pulling your neck with your hands.

ne_abs_leg_raise.name: Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight and together.
Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
tips: Bend your knees slightly if your back lifts.
commonMistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.

ne_abs_plank.name: Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Hold for the set duration.
tips: Squeeze your glutes and abs.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging or too high.

ne_arm_bench_dip.name: Chair Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a stable chair, hands beside your hips, then slide your hips forward.
Bend your elbows to 90°.
Push back up.
tips: The farther your feet, the harder it gets.
commonMistakes: Shoulders rising toward your ears.

ne_arm_wall_triceps.name: Close-grip Wall Push-up
steps: Hands on the wall shoulder-width apart, elbows close to your body.
Push up and down in a controlled way.
tips: Move slowly.
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out.

ne_arm_diamond_knee.name: Knee Diamond Push-up
steps: Get into a kneeling position with your hands forming a diamond.
Lower down and push back up.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging.

ne_shoulder_arm_circles.name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand with your arms straight out to the sides.
Make small circles, then big ones, then switch direction.
tips: Keep the movement controlled.
commonMistakes: Shoulders shrugging up.

ne_shoulder_pike_knee.name: Knee Pike Push-up
steps: Start on your knees with your hips high, forming an inverted V.
Bend your elbows so your head moves toward the floor between your hands.
Push back up.
tips: Look toward your feet.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging.

ne_shoulder_pike.name: Pike Push-up
steps: Get into an inverted V position with straight legs.
Lower your head toward the floor, then push back up.
tips: The closer your feet, the harder it gets.
commonMistakes: Rounded back.

ne_back_superman.name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with your arms straight in front of you.
Lift your arms and legs at the same time.
Hold for 1-2 seconds, then lower.
tips: Keep your gaze on the floor.
commonMistakes: Craning the neck upward.

ne_back_bird_dog.name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on all fours.
Extend your right arm and left leg.
Return, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your pelvis stable.
commonMistakes: Arched back.

ne_back_reverse_plank.name: Reverse Plank
steps: Sit with your hands behind you and lift your hips.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Hold.
tips: Push your shoulders away from your ears.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging.

ne_leg_squat.name: Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
tips: Keep your chest upright.
commonMistakes: Knees caving inward.

ne_leg_lunge.name: Lunge
steps: Take a big step forward.
Lower your back knee almost to the floor.
Push back, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your front knee from going past your toes.
commonMistakes: Leaning the torso.

ne_leg_jump_squat.name: Jump Squat
steps: Squat, then jump explosively.
Land softly back into a squat.
tips: Land with your knees bent.
commonMistakes: Landing stiffly.

ne_full_march.name: Marching in Place
steps: Lift your knees alternately while swinging your arms.
Keep a steady rhythm.
tips: Keep an upright posture.
commonMistakes: Hunching over.

ne_full_burpee_no_jump.name: No-jump Burpee
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step your feet back into a plank.
Return to the squat, then stand up.
tips: Keep a steady rhythm.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging in the plank.

ne_full_burpee.name: Burpee
steps: Squat down, jump your feet back into a plank, do a push-up, return, then jump high.
tips: Land softly.
commonMistakes: Arched back.

pb_chest_knee_pushup.name: Knee Chest Push-up
steps: Place both hands on the blue circles, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your knees to the floor, body straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the board for 2 seconds with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Tighten your abs so your hips do not drop.
commonMistakes: Hips piking up or sagging.
Elbows flared out to 90 degrees.

pb_chest_pushup.name: Standard Chest Push-up
steps: Hands on the blue circles, legs straight and resting on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it almost touches the board, then push up.
tips: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push.
commonMistakes: Head dropping or craning up too much.
Half reps (not lowering fully).

pb_chest_decline.name: Decline Chest Push-up
steps: Rest both feet on a stable chair or bench at knee height.
Hands on the blue circles, body straight.
Lower your chest in a controlled 3 seconds, then push up hard.
tips: Make sure the chair does not slide before you start.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging, causing the lower back to arch.

pb_shoulder_knee.name: Knee Shoulder Push-up
steps: Hands on the red circles, knees on the floor, hips slightly raised.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the board.
Push up while keeping your hips high.
tips: Focus on feeling the load in your front shoulders.
commonMistakes: Hips dropping, turning it into a regular push-up.

pb_shoulder_pike.name: Pike Push-up
steps: Hands on the red circles, feet close to your hands, hips high in an inverted V.
Lower your head toward the board with your elbows pointing back and out.
Push back up to the V position.
tips: The closer your feet are to your hands, the more load goes to your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Rounded back.
Bumping your head on the board by going too fast.

pb_shoulder_pike_elevated.name: Elevated Pike Push-up
steps: Rest your feet on a stable bench, hands on the red circles.
Raise your hips as high as possible so your arms and body form a sharp angle.
Lower your head in a controlled 3 seconds, then push up.
tips: Use a slow tempo to protect your shoulder joints.
commonMistakes: Too much load on the neck.

pb_back_plank.name: Yellow Zone Plank
steps: Hands on the yellow circles, arms straight under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Hold while pulling your shoulders away from your ears and tightening your abs.
tips: Note: the yellow zone is the manufacturer's hand-position guide. For a stronger lat workout, combine it with rope exercises (rows).
commonMistakes: Shoulders rising to your ears.
Hips sagging.

pb_back_pushup_pause.name: Paused Yellow Zone Push-up
steps: Hands on the yellow circles, body straight.
Lower your body and hold for 2 seconds at the bottom while pulling your shoulder blades back.
Push up.
tips: The pause builds control and shoulder blade stability.
commonMistakes: Holding your breath for too long.

pb_back_tempo.name: Slow Tempo Yellow Zone Push-up
steps: Hands on the yellow circles.
Lower for 4 seconds, hold 1 second at the bottom, rise for 1 second.
Keep your shoulder blades stable throughout.
tips: Reduce your reps if your form starts to break down.
commonMistakes: Speeding up at the end of the set.

pb_triceps_knee.name: Knee Triceps Push-up
steps: Hands on the green circles, knees on the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked against your body as you lower your chest.
Push up until your arms are straight.
tips: Imagine your elbows brushing the sides of your body.
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides.

pb_triceps_pushup.name: Triceps Push-up
steps: Hands on the green circles, legs straight.
Keep your elbows tucked and pointing back as you lower.
Push up, focusing on your triceps.
tips: Lock your elbows at the top in a controlled way, do not snap them.
commonMistakes: Wrists bent too much.

pb_triceps_decline.name: Decline Triceps Push-up
steps: Feet on a stable bench, hands on the green circles.
Lower your body with your elbows tucked, over 3 seconds.
Push up hard.
tips: Lower the bench height if your wrists feel strained.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging.

rope_bicep_curl.name: Rope Bicep Curl
steps: Stand on the board, hook the rope to the board and hold both handles.
Keep your elbows at your sides, palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows until the handles are near your shoulders, then lower slowly.
tips: Increase tension by shortening the rope.
commonMistakes: Swinging your body backward.
Elbows moving forward.

rope_grip_hold.name: Rope Grip Hold
steps: Stand on the board and hold the handles with the rope slightly taut.
Pull the handles to the sides of your body and hold.
Grip the handles firmly for the set duration.
tips: The goal is to build grip strength.
commonMistakes: Shrugging your shoulders.

rope_overhead_press.name: Rope Overhead Press
steps: Stand on the board with the handles at shoulder height and the rope behind your arms.
Press the handles straight up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower back to your shoulders in a controlled way.
tips: Tighten your abs so your back does not arch.
commonMistakes: Lower back arching.

rope_overhead_triceps.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand on the board with the rope passing behind your back and the handles behind your head.
Point your elbows forward, close to your ears.
Straighten your arms overhead, then bend slowly.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your head.
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out.

rope_row.name: Rope Bent-over Row
steps: Stand on the board, hinge your hips about 45 degrees, back straight.
Pull the handles toward your waist while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Release slowly until your arms are straight.
tips: This exercise complements the yellow zone for your lats.
commonMistakes: Rounded back.
Pulling with your shoulders instead of your back.

rope_upright_row.name: Rope Upright Row
steps: Stand on the board with the handles in front of your thighs.
Pull the handles up to your chest, leading with your elbows.
Lower in a controlled way.
tips: Do not raise your elbows higher than your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

rope_squat.name: Rope Squat
steps: Stand on the board shoulder-width apart with the handles at shoulder height.
Sit your hips back as if sitting down, chest upright.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
tips: Keep your knees in line with your toes.
commonMistakes: Knees caving inward.
Heels lifting.

rope_calf_raise.name: Rope Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the board with the handles at shoulder height.
Raise your heels as high as possible and hold for 1 second.
Lower slowly and stretch your calves at the bottom.
tips: Hold onto a wall if you need balance.
commonMistakes: Going too fast without a pause.

rope_woodchop.name: Rope Woodchop
steps: Stand on the board, holding the handle near one hip.
Pull diagonally upward across your body to the opposite side, rotating your torso.
Return slowly, repeat, then switch sides.
tips: The movement comes from your abs, not your arms.
commonMistakes: Twisting your knees and lower back.

rope_deadlift.name: Rope Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on the board with the handles in front of your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower the handles along your thighs with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
tips: Feel the stretch in the back of your thighs.
commonMistakes: Rounded back.

rope_thruster.name: Rope Squat to Press
steps: Stand on the board with the handles at your shoulders.
Squat deep, then stand up while pressing the handles overhead.
Lower the handles to your shoulders and repeat.
tips: Use the drive from your legs to help your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Legs and arms not moving as one.

ne_leg_glute_bridge.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Press your heels into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Hold briefly at the top while squeezing your glutes, then lower slowly.
tips: Imagine pushing the floor away with your heels.
commonMistakes: Over-arching the lower back at the top.
Pushing through the toes so the hamstrings cramp.

ne_leg_single_bridge.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other leg straight, raised in line with your thigh.
Press through the supporting heel and lift your hips until your body is straight.
Lower slowly without tilting your hips, finish all reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep both hip bones level; do not let one side drop.
commonMistakes: Rotating the hips toward the raised leg.
Going too fast so the glutes do not work.

ne_leg_calf_raise.name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart; hold a wall or chair if needed.
Lift your heels as high as you can onto the balls of your feet.
Hold for one second at the top, then lower your heels slowly.
tips: Lower over three counts so the calves work on the way down too.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees or leaning forward.
Bouncing without a pause at the top.

ne_leg_wall_sit.name: Wall Sit
steps: Lean your back against a wall with feet one step forward, hip-width apart.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees form a 90-degree angle.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, with hands on your thighs or crossed over your chest.
tips: Make sure your knees are directly above your ankles, not past your toes.
commonMistakes: Stopping halfway so the thighs are not parallel.
Pushing on the thighs with your hands for help.

ne_leg_single_deadlift.name: Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, arms in front of your body.
Hinge forward at the hips while the other leg lifts straight behind you.
Lower until your torso and rear leg are almost parallel to the floor, then stand back up by squeezing your glutes.
tips: Look at the floor slightly ahead of your foot to keep your balance.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back as you lean forward.
Opening the hips to the side so the body twists.

ne_abs_mountain_climber.name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with shoulders directly over your wrists.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then return it.
Alternate legs at a steady rhythm while keeping your hips low.
tips: Start slowly; speed up only if your hips stay steady.
commonMistakes: Hips piking up high.
Hands drifting forward so the shoulders lose support.

ne_abs_bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, legs raised with knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and rotate so your elbow meets the opposite knee while the other leg extends.
Switch sides in a controlled pedaling motion.
tips: Rotate from the ribs, not just by pulling your elbow to your knee.
commonMistakes: Pulling on your neck with your hands.
Pedaling too fast so the abs do not work.

ne_abs_flutter_kick.name: Flutter Kick
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips and both legs straight, lifted slightly off the floor.
Flutter your legs up and down alternately in small, quick movements.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout.
tips: The lower your legs, the harder it gets; lift them higher if your lower back arches.
commonMistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.
Bending the knees, which reduces the load.

ne_abs_v_up.name: V-Up
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your upper body and both legs together until your body forms a V, reaching your hands toward your toes.
Lower slowly with control instead of dropping.
tips: If you are not strong enough yet, bend your knees slightly as you rise.
commonMistakes: Swinging with momentum instead of using the abs.
Dropping the body and legs to the floor at the end.

ne_abs_hollow_hold.name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs a few centimeters so your body curves like a boat.
Hold the position, breathing in short, steady breaths.
tips: Lower your legs to make it harder; raise them if your lower back starts to lift.
commonMistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.
Holding your breath while holding the position.

ne_back_swimmer.name: Swimmer
steps: Lie face down with arms extended forward and legs straight behind you.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg a few centimeters off the floor.
Switch sides alternately with small swimming movements, keeping your neck neutral.
tips: Look at the floor so your neck does not lift too much.
commonMistakes: Looking up so the neck tenses.
Lifting so high that the lower back bends sharply.

ne_back_good_morning.name: Bodyweight Good Morning
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands behind your head, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward with a straight back until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Stand back up by squeezing your glutes.
tips: Imagine closing a car door with your backside to feel the hip hinge.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back as you bend.
Bending the knees so deeply that it becomes a squat.

ne_chest_incline_pushup.name: Incline Push-up
steps: Place both hands on the edge of a sturdy table, chair, or stair, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Straighten your body from head to heels, balanced on your toes.
Bend your elbows until your chest nears the edge, then push back up.
tips: The lower the hand surface, the harder it gets; lower it gradually every few weeks.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging or rising so the body is not straight.
Elbows flaring out to a full 90 degrees.

ne_chest_decline_pushup.name: Decline Push-up
steps: Place your toes on a chair or bench with hands on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Straighten your body from head to heels, abs and glutes tight.
Lower your chest until it almost touches the floor, then push back up.
tips: Raise the bench height gradually; the higher it is, the more load goes onto the shoulders.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging so the lower back arches.
Head dropping or lifting too much.

ne_shoulder_plank_tap.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with feet slightly wider than your shoulders for stability.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back and switch sides; keep your hips from swaying.
tips: Widen your feet if your hips still sway; narrow them as you get stronger.
commonMistakes: Hips rotating or swaying when one hand lifts.
Rushing so the shoulders lose control.

ne_full_inchworm.name: Inchworm
steps: Stand tall, then fold forward and place both hands on the floor (knees may bend slightly).
Walk your hands forward until your body is in a plank position.
Walk your feet toward your hands, then stand up and repeat.
tips: Keep your abs tight while walking your hands so your hips do not sag.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging in the plank position.
Taking steps that are too short, losing the stretch benefit.

pb_chest_bottom_hold.name: Chest Push-up Bottom Hold
steps: Hands on the blue circles, body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it hovers just above the board and hold at the bottom.
Keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your body and breathe steadily, then push up.
tips: Hold at the hardest point; stop if your form starts to break down.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging during the hold.
Holding your breath while holding the position.

pb_shoulder_pike_hold.name: Pike Push-up Hold
steps: Hands on the red circles, hips lifted high so your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the board to mid-range, then hold.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
tips: Push the floor away to keep the shoulders active.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back while holding.
Elbows flaring out to the sides.

pb_triceps_bottom_hold.name: Triceps Push-up Bottom Hold
steps: Hands on the green circles, elbows tucked against your body, body straight.
Lower your chest just above the board with elbows still brushing your ribs and hold.
Push up forcefully when time is up.
tips: Keep your elbows against your body; that is where the triceps work hardest.
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring out so the load shifts to the chest.
Hips sagging during the hold.

rope_front_raise.name: Front Raise with Rope
steps: Stand on the board, step on the rope, and hold the ends with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly with control.
tips: Raise over two counts and lower over three.
commonMistakes: Swinging the body backward to help lift.
Lifting above shoulder height so the neck tenses.

rope_good_morning.name: Good Morning with Rope
steps: Stand on the board, step on the rope, and hold it in front of your shoulders with elbows forward.
Push your hips back and lean forward with a straight back.
Stand back up by squeezing your glutes; the rope keeps the load throughout.
tips: Keep the rope taut from the standing position.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back as you bend.
Locking the knees so the hamstrings overstretch.

rope_kickback.name: Triceps Kickback with Rope
steps: Stand on the board, step on the rope, and lean forward with a straight back.
Tuck your elbows against your body with forearms hanging, holding the rope ends.
Straighten your arms behind you while keeping your elbows still, then return slowly.
tips: Hold for one second with arms straight to feel the triceps contract.
commonMistakes: Elbows moving up and down instead of staying still.
Standing up to help swing the rope.

rope_reverse_lunge.name: Reverse Lunge with Rope
steps: Stand on the board, step on the rope with one foot, and hold the ends in front of your chest.
Step the other foot back and lower until both knees form about a 90-degree angle.
Push through the front foot to stand up, finish all reps, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso upright and your front knee directly above your ankle.
commonMistakes: Front knee traveling past the toes.
Leaning forward so balance is lost.

rope_overhead_squat.name: Overhead Squat with Rope
steps: Stand on the board, step on the rope, and raise your arms straight overhead holding the ends.
Lower into a squat while keeping your arms straight overhead and chest open.
Drive through your heels to stand up without your arms drifting forward.
tips: If your arms drift forward, reduce squat depth and work on shoulder mobility first.
commonMistakes: Arms drifting forward so the lower back arches.
Heels lifting as you descend.

cd_walk_brisk.name: Brisk Walk
cd_walk_brisk.summary: Walk at a brisk pace for 20 minutes. Your breathing rises but you can still talk. A safe aerobic base for everyone.
tips: Swing your arms loosely and take slightly shorter, quicker steps.
Talk test: you should be able to say a full sentence without gasping.
commonMistakes: Overstriding so your heel slams down.
Starting fast without a warm-up.

cd_walk_run_beginner.name: Beginner Run-Walk
cd_walk_run_beginner.summary: Alternate 1 minute of easy jogging with 2 minutes of walking, 8 times. A bridge from walking to running that spares your joints.
tips: Jog as slowly as you can; if you gasp, slow down.
Do not skip the walking minutes: that is when your body adapts.
commonMistakes: Running too fast in the first minute.
Lengthening the jog before your body is ready.

cd_easy_run.name: Easy Run
cd_easy_run.summary: A 25-minute conversational-pace run. The foundation of running training: most of your runs should feel like this.
tips: Pick a pace that lets you speak in full sentences.
Easy is deliberate: running slowly today makes you stronger next week.
commonMistakes: Running so fast that every session feels hard.
Comparing your pace with other people.

cd_recovery_run.name: Recovery Run
cd_recovery_run.summary: A very slow 15-minute run that helps you recover the day after a hard session.
tips: Slower than an Easy Run; when in doubt, just walk.
Best the day after intervals, tempo, or leg day.
commonMistakes: Turning it into a tempo session.
Forcing a run when your body is very tired or sore.

cd_long_run.name: Long Run
cd_long_run.summary: A 60-minute run at an easy pace to build endurance. Once a week, and no more than about a third of your weekly running.
tips: Carry water and start at a pace that feels too slow.
Add at most 10% duration per week.
commonMistakes: Starting too fast and running out of energy.
Adding too much duration at once.

cd_fartlek.name: Fartlek
cd_fartlek.summary: Alternate 1 minute fast with 2 minutes easy, 6 times. Builds speed without strict pacing.
tips: The fast parts feel strong but controlled, not a sprint.
The easy parts must be truly easy so your breathing recovers.
commonMistakes: Going too hard on early repeats and fading at the end.
Skipping the warm-up.

cd_tempo_run.name: Tempo Run
cd_tempo_run.summary: After a warm-up, run 20 minutes at a comfortably hard pace. Trains your body to hold a high speed for longer.
tips: The right tempo: you can only say 3-4 words at a time.
Hold the same pace from start to finish.
commonMistakes: Starting too fast and slowing at the end.
Scheduling it the day before heavy leg training.

cd_intervals_30_30.name: Intervals 30/30
cd_intervals_30_30.summary: 8 repeats of 30 seconds fast running with 30 seconds of easy jogging. Builds aerobic capacity with less joint load.
tips: Fast, but keep your running form tidy.
Keep the same effort across all repeats.
commonMistakes: Sprinting flat out so you cannot finish all repeats.
Stopping completely during the easy part.

cd_intervals_4x4.name: Intervals 4x4
cd_intervals_4x4.summary: 4 repeats of 4 minutes hard running with 3 minutes of jogging. The classic VO2max session; do it at most once a week.
tips: Hard effort you can hold for 4 minutes.
Jog during recovery instead of stopping.
commonMistakes: Starting the first repeat too fast.
Doing it two days in a row.

cd_hill_repeats.name: Hill Repeats
cd_hill_repeats.summary: 6 hill efforts of 40 seconds at hard effort, walking back down. Strengthens your legs and improves running efficiency.
tips: Pick a gentle, safe hill that is long enough.
Lean slightly forward and drive your knees.
commonMistakes: Choosing a hill so steep that your form breaks down.
Running quickly back down the hill.

plan_easy_mix.name: Easy · Mixed 5 Days
plan_easy_mix.summary: Three bodyweight strength days alternating with two light cardio days, then rest on Saturday and Sunday. Great for beginners building a habit.
tips: Focus on form, not on the number of reps.
Tuesday and Thursday cardio should feel light: you can still speak full sentences.
Increase the load only after two weeks feel easy.

6.name: Active rest
6.note: An easy 15-20 minute walk and light stretching. Optional; feel free to fully relax.

7.name: Full rest
7.note: Sleep well, eat regularly, and drink water. Muscles get stronger while recovering, not while training.

plan_easy_full.name: Easy · Workout 5 Days
